{{Quote|We're the Protectors. Pro-tec-tors. We don't solve problems by slaughtering them!|Tad Belanger|<ref name="Unstable" />}}
The '''Second Battalion''' of the [[Republic Medical Corps]], more commonly known as the '''Protectors''', was a humanitarian division that served alongside the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] on battlefields across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], conducting rescue, reconnaissance, and evacuation operations to help civilians who were caught in the crossfire. Nicknamed the Protectors by a group of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] orphans during the [[Battle of Corellia]] in the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Second Battalion was later deployed on the disaster-stricken [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Makeb]], where they worked to evacuate Makeb's civilians in the face of the world's impending destruction. The Protectors were primarily non-combat, with their ranks staffed by civilians and ex-military volunteers, and they strove to avoid violence and save as many as lives as possible, regardless of whether they were enemies or not.
